* '''Printed text''' (this page): as given in the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet (official text as of 15 March 2010; the surviving copy was re-made 4 April 2010)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of March 15, 2010"; PDF dated 4 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If opponent's [Virtual Block 6] card just added a destiny to total power or attrition here, draw two destiny, choose one, and subtract it from their attrition and total power. Your characters here are immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 3.” (the printed slip shows the pilot icon with 2). The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-03-Grotto_Werribee.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-grottowerribee-pre.gif]]) print it. The PC website card list (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) shows the same text with the pilot icon written out and “Clash of Sabers and attrition <3” (capitals and spacing only, not a separate version).<ref name="cl-1263_4-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
